description: Every AnyHook app is also an email inbox: mail sent to {user}.{app}@anyhook.net becomes an event (type email.received) you can read with anyhook_events. Returns the address and webhook URL for one of your apps.

api_key.description: API key (ahk_live_...) from anyhook_quickstart. Only needed over HTTP when no Authorization header is set; ignored over stdio.

app.description: App slug (from anyhook_apps_list). Defaults to your first app.

name: anyhook_inbox
title: Get this app's email inbox address
